article.title: Spanish Tenants Have Had Enough
article.author: tfrasca@yahoo.com
article.content: DSA’s Housing Justice Commission hopes to learn from Spanish tenant organizers as their struggle escalates following the eviction and death of Maricarmen Abascal. The commission is backing vigils in solidarity with the general strike called in Spain for Nov. 11. The post Spanish Tenants Have Had Enough appeared first on Democratic Left .
